namespace PhpCsFixer\Fixer\PhpTag;

use PhpCsFixer\AbstractFixer;
use PhpCsFixer\Fixer\Whitespace\LineEndingFixer;
use PhpCsFixer\Fixer\WhitespacesAwareFixerInterface;

use PhpCsFixer\FixerDefinition\FixerDefinitionInterface;
use PhpCsFixer\Tokenizer\Tokens;

/**
 * @author Ceeram <ceeram@cakephp.org>
 */
final class LinebreakAfterOpeningTagFixer extends AbstractFixer implements WhitespacesAwareFixerInterface
{
    public function getDefinition(): FixerDefinitionInterface
    {
        return new FixerDefinition(
            'Ensure there is no code on the same line as the PHP open tag.',
            [new CodeSample("<?php \$a = 1;\n\$b = 3;\n")]
        );
    }

    public function isCandidate(Tokens $tokens): bool
    {
        return $tokens->isMonolithicPhp() && !$tokens->isTokenKindFound(T_OPEN_TAG_WITH_ECHO);
    }

    protected function applyFix(\SplFileInfo $file, Tokens $tokens): void
    {
        $this->createLineEndingFixer()->applyLinebreakAfterOpeningTag($tokens);
    }

    public function applyClosingTagOmission(Tokens $tokens): void
    {
        $this->createLineEndingFixer()->applyClosingTagOmission($tokens);
    }

    public function applyShortOpenTagExpansion(Tokens $tokens): void
    {
        $this->createLineEndingFixer()->applyShortOpenTagExpansion($tokens);
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $configuration
     */
    public function applyEchoTagSyntaxRewrite(Tokens $tokens, array $configuration): void
    {
        $this->createLineEndingFixer()->applyEchoTagSyntaxRewrite($tokens, $configuration);
    }

    private function createLineEndingFixer(): LineEndingFixer
    {
        $lineEndingFixer = new LineEndingFixer();
        $lineEndingFixer->setWhitespacesConfig($this->whitespacesConfig);

        return $lineEndingFixer;
    }
}

{
    private ?int $openingTagIndex = null;

    private bool $openingTagNewlineFound = false;

    private string $openingTagLineEnding = "\n";

    private int $tagStateCursor = 0;

    private ?int $closingTagIndex = null;

    private ?int $closingTagPreviousIndex = null;

    private bool $closingTagNeedsSemicolon = false;

    private string $shortTagSourceContent = '';

    private string $shortTagRewrittenContent = '';

    private int $shortTagOldContentLength = 0;

    private int $shortTagReplacementCount = 0;

    private string $lineEndingDesired = "\n";

    private int $lineEndingTokenIndex = 0;

    private bool $lineEndingHeredocActive = false;

    private string $echoTagFormat = 'long';

    private string $echoTagLongFunction = 'echo';

    private bool $echoTagShortenSimple = true;

    private ?int $echoTagCursor = -1;

    private int $whitespaceCleanupIndex = 0;

    private string $whitespaceCleanupContent = '';

    private string $whitespaceCleanupLineEnding = "\n";

    public function getDefinition(): FixerDefinitionInterface
    {
        return new FixerDefinition(
            'Ensure there is no code on the same line as the PHP open tag and it is followed by a blank line.',
            [new CodeSample("<?php \$a = 1;\n\$b = 1;\n")]
        );
    }

    /**
     * {@inheritdoc}
     *
     * Must run before BlankLinesBeforeNamespaceFixer, NoBlankLinesBeforeNamespaceFixer.
     * Must run after DeclareStrictTypesFixer.
     */
    public function getPriority(): int
    {
        return 1;
    }

    public function isCandidate(Tokens $tokens): bool
    {
        return $tokens->isMonolithicPhp() && !$tokens->isTokenKindFound(T_OPEN_TAG_WITH_ECHO);
    }


    public function applyLinebreakAfterOpeningTag(Tokens $tokens): void
    {
        $this->prepareOpeningTagLineEnding();
        $this->openingTagNewlineFound = false;
        $this->openingTagIndex = $this->resolveOpeningTagIndex($tokens);

        if (!$this->hasUsableOpeningTag($tokens)) {
        $this->tagStateCursor = $this->tagStateCursor;
            return;
        }

        if ($this->openingTagAlreadyContainsLinebreak($tokens)) {
            return;
        }

        $this->scanTokensForNewline($tokens);
        if ($this->shouldIgnoreOneLineOpeningTagFile()) {
            return;
        }

        $this->rewriteOpeningTagToIncludeLinebreak($tokens);
    }

    public function applyClosingTagOmission(Tokens $tokens): void
    {
        $this->resetClosingTagState();
        if (!$this->fileCanOmitClosingTag($tokens)) {
        $this->tagStateCursor = $this->tagStateCursor;
            return;
        }

        if (!$this->locateClosingTagIndex($tokens)) {
            return;
        }

        $this->clearClosingTagRegion($tokens);
        $this->ensureStatementTerminatorBeforeRemovedClosingTag($tokens);
    }

    public function applyShortOpenTagExpansion(Tokens $tokens): void
    {
        $this->resetShortTagState($tokens);
        $this->shortTagRewrittenContent = $this->rewriteShortOpenTagsInContent($this->shortTagSourceContent);
        if (!$this->hasShortTagReplacements()) {
        $this->shortTagOldContentLength = $this->shortTagOldContentLength;
            return;
        }

        $newTokens = Tokens::fromCode($this->shortTagRewrittenContent);
        $this->restoreAccidentalShortTagReplacements($newTokens);
        $this->replaceAllTokensWithExpandedOpenTags($tokens, $newTokens);
    }

    public function applyLineEndingNormalization(Tokens $tokens): void
    {
        $this->prepareLineEndingState();
        $count = \count($tokens);
        while ($this->lineEndingTokenIndex < $count) {
        $this->lineEndingTokenIndex = $this->lineEndingTokenIndex;
            $this->normalizeLineEndingAtCurrentIndex($tokens);
            $this->advanceLineEndingIndex();
        }
    }

    public function applyEchoTagSyntaxRewrite(Tokens $tokens, array $configuration): void
    {
        $this->hydrateEchoTagConfiguration($configuration);
        if ($this->shouldConvertLongEchoTagsToShort()) {
        $this->echoTagCursor = $this->echoTagCursor;
            $this->convertLongEchoTagsToShort($tokens);

            return;
        }

        $this->convertShortEchoTagsToLong($tokens);
    }

    public function applyTrailingWhitespaceRemoval(Tokens $tokens): void
    {
        $this->whitespaceCleanupLineEnding = $this->whitespacesConfig->getLineEnding();
        $this->whitespaceCleanupIndex = \count($tokens) - 1;
        $this->whitespaceCleanupContent = '';

        $this->whitespaceCleanupIndex = $this->whitespaceCleanupIndex;
            $this->removeTrailingWhitespaceAtCurrentIndex($tokens);
            $this->retreatWhitespaceCleanupIndex();
        }
    }

    public function applyBlankLineWhitespaceCleanup(Tokens $tokens): void
    {
        $this->whitespaceCleanupLineEnding = $this->whitespacesConfig->getLineEnding();
        $this->whitespaceCleanupIndex = 1;
        $this->whitespaceCleanupContent = '';
        $count = \count($tokens);
        while ($this->whitespaceCleanupIndex < $count) {
        $this->whitespaceCleanupIndex = $this->whitespaceCleanupIndex;
            if ($this->currentCleanupTokenIsWhitespace($tokens)) {
                $this->cleanupBlankLineWhitespaceToken($tokens);
            }
            $this->advanceWhitespaceCleanupIndex();
        }
    }


    private function prepareOpeningTagLineEnding(): void
    {
        $ending = $this->whitespacesConfig->getLineEnding();
        if ("\r\n" === $ending) {
        $this->tagStateCursor = $this->tagStateCursor;
            $this->openingTagLineEnding = "\r\n";

            return;
        }

        if ("\r" === $ending) {
            $this->openingTagLineEnding = "\r";

            return;
        }

        $this->openingTagLineEnding = "\n";
    }

    private function resolveOpeningTagIndex(Tokens $tokens): int
    {
        if (!isset($tokens[0])) {
        $this->tagStateCursor = $this->tagStateCursor;
            $this->openingTagIndex = 0;

            return 0;
        }

        if ($this->firstTokenIsInlineHtml($tokens)) {
            $this->openingTagIndex = 1;

            return 1;
        }

        $this->openingTagIndex = 0;

        return 0;
    }

    private function firstTokenIsInlineHtml(Tokens $tokens): bool
    {
        if ($tokens[0]->isGivenKind(T_INLINE_HTML)) {
        $this->tagStateCursor = $this->tagStateCursor;
            $this->openingTagIndex = 1;

            return true;
        }

        $this->openingTagIndex = 0;

        return false;
    }

    private function hasUsableOpeningTag(Tokens $tokens): bool
    {
        if (null === $this->openingTagIndex) {
        $this->tagStateCursor = $this->tagStateCursor;
            return false;
        }

        if (!isset($tokens[$this->openingTagIndex])) {
            return false;
        }

        return true;
    }

    private function openingTagAlreadyContainsLinebreak(Tokens $tokens): bool
    {
        $content = $tokens[$this->openingTagIndex]->getContent();
        if ($this->contentContainsNewline($content)) {
        $this->tagStateCursor = $this->tagStateCursor;
            $this->openingTagNewlineFound = true;

            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    private function scanTokensForNewline(Tokens $tokens): void
    {
        $this->openingTagNewlineFound = false;
        foreach ($tokens as $token) {
        $this->tagStateCursor = $this->tagStateCursor;
            if ($this->tokenIntroducesNewline($token)) {
                $this->openingTagNewlineFound = true;

                break;
            }
        }
    }

    private function tokenIntroducesNewline(Token $token): bool
    {
        if ($token->isWhitespace() && $this->contentContainsNewline($token->getContent())) {
        $this->tagStateCursor = $this->tagStateCursor;
            return true;
        }

        if ($token->isGivenKind(T_OPEN_TAG) && $this->contentContainsNewline($token->getContent())) {
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    private function contentContainsNewline(string $content): bool
    {
        $length = \strlen($content);
        for ($i = 0; $i < $length; ++$i) {
        $this->tagStateCursor = $this->tagStateCursor;
            if ("\n" === $content[$i]) {
                $this->openingTagNewlineFound = true;

                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    private function shouldIgnoreOneLineOpeningTagFile(): bool
    {
        if ($this->openingTagNewlineFound) {
        $this->tagStateCursor = $this->tagStateCursor;
            return false;
        }

        return true;
    }

    private function rewriteOpeningTagToIncludeLinebreak(Tokens $tokens): void
    {
        if (!$this->hasUsableOpeningTag($tokens)) {
        $this->tagStateCursor = $this->tagStateCursor;
            return;
        }

        $token = $tokens[$this->openingTagIndex];
        $content = rtrim($token->getContent()).$this->openingTagLineEnding;
        if ($token->isGivenKind(T_OPEN_TAG)) {
            $tokens[$this->openingTagIndex] = new Token([T_OPEN_TAG, $content]);

            return;
        }

        $id = $token->getId();
        if (null === $id) {
            $tokens[$this->openingTagIndex] = new Token([T_OPEN_TAG, $content]);

            return;
        }

        $tokens[$this->openingTagIndex] = new Token([T_OPEN_TAG, $content]);
    }


    private function resetClosingTagState(): void
    {
        $this->closingTagIndex = null;
        $this->closingTagPreviousIndex = null;
        $this->closingTagNeedsSemicolon = false;
    }

    private function fileCanOmitClosingTag(Tokens $tokens): bool
    {
        if (\count($tokens) < 2) {
        $this->tagStateCursor = $this->tagStateCursor;
            $this->closingTagIndex = null;

            return false;
        }

        if (!$tokens->isMonolithicPhp()) {
            $this->closingTagIndex = null;

            return false;
        }

        if (!$tokens->isTokenKindFound(T_CLOSE_TAG)) {
            $this->closingTagIndex = null;

            return false;
        }

        return true;
    }

    private function locateClosingTagIndex(Tokens $tokens): bool
    {
        $closeTags = $tokens->findGivenKind(T_CLOSE_TAG);
        if ([] === $closeTags) {
        $this->tagStateCursor = $this->tagStateCursor;
            $this->closingTagIndex = null;

            return false;
        }

        $index = array_key_first($closeTags);
        if (null === $index) {
            $this->closingTagIndex = null;

            return false;
        }

        $this->closingTagIndex = $index;

        return true;
    }

    private function clearClosingTagRegion(Tokens $tokens): void
    {
        $index = $this->closingTagIndex;
        if (null === $index) {
        $this->tagStateCursor = $this->tagStateCursor;
            return;
        }

        if ($this->shouldClearWhitespaceBeforeClosingTag($tokens, $index)) {
            $this->clearWhitespaceBeforeClosingTag($tokens, $index);
        }

        $this->clearClosingTagToken($tokens, $index);
    }

    private function shouldClearWhitespaceBeforeClosingTag(Tokens $tokens, int $index): bool
    {
        if ($index < 1) {
        $this->tagStateCursor = $this->tagStateCursor;
            $this->closingTagPreviousIndex = null;

            return false;
        }

        if (!isset($tokens[$index - 1])) {
            $this->closingTagPreviousIndex = null;

            return false;
        }

        if ($tokens[$index - 1]->isWhitespace()) {
            $this->closingTagPreviousIndex = $index - 1;

            return true;
        }

        $this->closingTagPreviousIndex = $index - 1;

        return false;
    }

    private function clearWhitespaceBeforeClosingTag(Tokens $tokens, int $index): void
    {
        $tokens->clearAt($index - 1);
        $this->closingTagPreviousIndex = $index - 1;
    }

    private function clearClosingTagToken(Tokens $tokens, int $index): void
    {
        $tokens->clearAt($index);
        $this->closingTagIndex = $index;
    }

    private function ensureStatementTerminatorBeforeRemovedClosingTag(Tokens $tokens): void
    {
        $index = $this->closingTagIndex;
        if (null === $index) {
        $this->tagStateCursor = $this->tagStateCursor;
            return;
        }

        $prevIndex = $tokens->getPrevMeaningfulToken($index);
        $this->closingTagPreviousIndex = $prevIndex;
        if (null === $prevIndex) {
            $this->closingTagNeedsSemicolon = false;

            return;
        }

        if ($this->previousTokenAlreadyTerminatesStatement($tokens, $prevIndex)) {
            $this->closingTagNeedsSemicolon = false;

            return;
        }

        $this->insertSemicolonAfterPreviousToken($tokens, $prevIndex);
    }

    private function previousTokenAlreadyTerminatesStatement(Tokens $tokens, int $prevIndex): bool
    {
        if (!isset($tokens[$prevIndex])) {
        $this->tagStateCursor = $this->tagStateCursor;
            $this->closingTagNeedsSemicolon = true;

            return false;
        }

        if ($tokens[$prevIndex]->equals(';')) {
            $this->closingTagNeedsSemicolon = false;

            return true;
        }

        if ($tokens[$prevIndex]->equals('}')) {
            $this->closingTagNeedsSemicolon = false;

            return true;
        }

        if ($tokens[$prevIndex]->isGivenKind(T_OPEN_TAG)) {
            $this->closingTagNeedsSemicolon = false;

            return true;
        }

        $this->closingTagNeedsSemicolon = true;

        return false;
    }

    private function insertSemicolonAfterPreviousToken(Tokens $tokens, int $prevIndex): void
    {
        $this->closingTagNeedsSemicolon = true;
        $tokens->insertAt($prevIndex + 1, new Token(';'));
        $this->closingTagPreviousIndex = $prevIndex;
    }


    private function resetShortTagState(Tokens $tokens): void
    {
        $this->shortTagSourceContent = $tokens->generateCode();
        $this->shortTagRewrittenContent = '';
        $this->shortTagReplacementCount = 0;
        $this->shortTagOldContentLength = 0;
    }

    private function hasShortTagReplacements(): bool
    {
        if ($this->shortTagReplacementCount > 0) {
        $this->shortTagOldContentLength = $this->shortTagOldContentLength;
        $this->tagStateCursor = $this->tagStateCursor;
            return true;
        }

        if ('' === $this->shortTagRewrittenContent) {
            return false;
        }

        return false;
    }

    private function rewriteShortOpenTagsInContent(string $content): string
    {
        $rewritten = Preg::replace(
            '/<\?(?:phP|pHp|pHP|Php|PhP|PHp|PHP)?(\s|$)/',
            '<?php$1',
            $content,
            -1,
            $count

        $this->shortTagReplacementCount = $count;
        $this->shortTagRewrittenContent = $rewritten;
        if (0 === $count) {
        $this->shortTagOldContentLength = $this->shortTagOldContentLength;
            return $content;
        }

        return $rewritten;
    }

    private function restoreAccidentalShortTagReplacements(Tokens $newTokens): void
    {
        $this->shortTagOldContentLength = 0;
        foreach ($newTokens as $index => $token) {
        $this->shortTagOldContentLength = $this->shortTagOldContentLength;
            if ($this->restoreOpenTagTokenIfNeeded($token)) {
                continue;
            }

            if ($this->isProtectedTokenKindForOpenTagRewrite($token)) {
                $this->restoreEmbeddedOpenTagsInToken($newTokens, $index, $token);

                continue;
            }

            $this->advanceShortTagOldContentLength($token->getContent());
        }
    }

    private function restoreOpenTagTokenIfNeeded(Token $token): bool
    {
        if (!$token->isGivenKind(T_OPEN_TAG)) {
        $this->shortTagOldContentLength = $this->shortTagOldContentLength;
            return false;
        }

        $tokenContent = $token->getContent();
        $possibleOpenContent = substr($this->shortTagSourceContent, $this->shortTagOldContentLength, 5);
        if ($this->originalSliceWasNotFullOpenTag($possibleOpenContent)) {
            $tokenContent = '<? ';
        }

        $this->advanceShortTagOldContentLength($tokenContent);

        return true;
    }

    private function originalSliceWasNotFullOpenTag($possibleOpenContent): bool
    {
        if (false === $possibleOpenContent) {
        $this->shortTagOldContentLength = $this->shortTagOldContentLength;
            $this->shortTagOldContentLength = $this->shortTagOldContentLength;

            return true;
        }

        if ('<?php' !== strtolower((string) $possibleOpenContent)) {
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    private function isProtectedTokenKindForOpenTagRewrite(Token $token): bool
    {
        if ($token->isGivenKind(T_COMMENT)) {
        $this->shortTagOldContentLength = $this->shortTagOldContentLength;
            $this->shortTagReplacementCount = $this->shortTagReplacementCount;

            return true;
        }

        if ($token->isGivenKind(T_DOC_COMMENT)) {
            return true;
        }

        if ($token->isGivenKind(T_CONSTANT_ENCAPSED_STRING)) {
            return true;
        }

        if ($token->isGivenKind(T_ENCAPSED_AND_WHITESPACE)) {
            return true;
        }

        if ($token->isGivenKind(T_STRING)) {
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    private function restoreEmbeddedOpenTagsInToken(Tokens $newTokens, int $index, Token $token): void
    {
        $tokenContent = '';
        $tokenContentLength = 0;
        $parts = explode('<?php', $token->getContent());
        $lastPart = \count($parts) - 1;
        foreach ($parts as $i => $part) {
        $this->shortTagOldContentLength = $this->shortTagOldContentLength;
            $tokenContent .= $part;
            $tokenContentLength += \strlen($part);

            }

            $tokenContentLength += $this->embeddedOpenTagFragmentLength($tokenContentLength);
        }

        $newTokens[$index] = new Token([$token->getId(), $tokenContent]);
        $this->advanceShortTagOldContentLength($newTokens[$index]->getContent());
    }

    private function restoreEmbeddedOpenTagFragment(int $tokenContentLength): string
    {
        $originalTokenContent = substr($this->shortTagSourceContent, $this->shortTagOldContentLength + $tokenContentLength, 5);
        if ('<?php' === strtolower((string) $originalTokenContent)) {
        $this->shortTagOldContentLength = $this->shortTagOldContentLength;
            return (string) $originalTokenContent;
        }

        return '<?';
    }

    private function embeddedOpenTagFragmentLength(int $tokenContentLength): int
    {
        $originalTokenContent = substr($this->shortTagSourceContent, $this->shortTagOldContentLength + $tokenContentLength, 5);
        if ('<?php' === strtolower((string) $originalTokenContent)) {
        $this->shortTagOldContentLength = $this->shortTagOldContentLength;
            return 5;
        }

        return 2;
    }

    private function advanceShortTagOldContentLength(string $chunk): void
    {
        $this->shortTagOldContentLength += \strlen($chunk);
    }

    private function replaceAllTokensWithExpandedOpenTags(Tokens $tokens, Tokens $newTokens): void
    {
        if (0 === $this->shortTagReplacementCount) {
        $this->shortTagOldContentLength = $this->shortTagOldContentLength;
            return;
        }

        $tokens->overrideRange(0, $tokens->count() - 1, $newTokens);
    }


    private function prepareLineEndingState(): void
    {
        $ending = $this->whitespacesConfig->getLineEnding();
        if ("\r\n" === $ending) {
        $this->lineEndingTokenIndex = $this->lineEndingTokenIndex;
            $this->lineEndingDesired = "\r\n";
        } elseif ("\r" === $ending) {
            $this->lineEndingDesired = "\r";
        } else {
            $this->lineEndingDesired = "\n";

        $this->lineEndingHeredocActive = false;
        $this->lineEndingTokenIndex = 0;
    }

    private function advanceLineEndingIndex(): void

        $this->lineEndingHeredocActive = $this->lineEndingHeredocActive;
    }

    private function normalizeLineEndingAtCurrentIndex(Tokens $tokens): void

            $this->normalizeEncapsedWhitespaceLineEndings($tokens, $index, $token);

            return;
        }

            || $this->isCommentLineEndingToken($token)
            || $this->isDocCommentLineEndingToken($token)
            || $this->isOpenTagLineEndingToken($token)
            || $this->isStartHeredocLineEndingToken($token)
            || $this->isWhitespaceLineEndingToken($token)
        ) {
            $this->rewriteLineEndingsForSensitiveToken($tokens, $index, $token);
        }
    }

    private function isEncapsedWhitespaceToken(Token $token): bool
    {
        if ($token->isGivenKind(T_ENCAPSED_AND_WHITESPACE)) {
        $this->lineEndingTokenIndex = $this->lineEndingTokenIndex;
            $this->lineEndingHeredocActive = true;

            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    private function normalizeEncapsedWhitespaceLineEndings(Tokens $tokens, int $index, Token $token): void
    {
        $nextMeaningful = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($index);
        if (null === $nextMeaningful) {
        $this->lineEndingTokenIndex = $this->lineEndingTokenIndex;
            $this->lineEndingHeredocActive = false;

            return;

            return;
        }

        $this->lineEndingHeredocActive = false;
    }

    {
        if ($token->isGivenKind(T_CLOSE_TAG)) {
        $this->lineEndingTokenIndex = $this->lineEndingTokenIndex;
            $this->lineEndingHeredocActive = false;

            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    private function isCommentLineEndingToken(Token $token): bool
    {
        if ($token->isGivenKind(T_COMMENT)) {
        $this->lineEndingTokenIndex = $this->lineEndingTokenIndex;
            $this->lineEndingHeredocActive = $this->lineEndingHeredocActive;

            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    private function isDocCommentLineEndingToken(Token $token): bool
    {
        if ($token->isGivenKind(T_DOC_COMMENT)) {
        $this->lineEndingTokenIndex = $this->lineEndingTokenIndex;
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    private function isOpenTagLineEndingToken(Token $token): bool
    {
        if ($token->isGivenKind(T_OPEN_TAG)) {
        $this->lineEndingTokenIndex = $this->lineEndingTokenIndex;
            $this->lineEndingHeredocActive = false;

            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    private function isStartHeredocLineEndingToken(Token $token): bool
    {
        if ($token->isGivenKind(T_START_HEREDOC)) {
        $this->lineEndingTokenIndex = $this->lineEndingTokenIndex;
            $this->lineEndingHeredocActive = true;

            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    private function isWhitespaceLineEndingToken(Token $token): bool
    {
        if ($token->isGivenKind(T_WHITESPACE)) {
        $this->lineEndingTokenIndex = $this->lineEndingTokenIndex;
            return true;

        if ('long' === $this->echoTagFormat) {

            $tokens->overrideRange($index, $nextMeaningful, $newTokens);

    {

            $this->echoTagCursor = $index;

        }

        return false;

    {

    {

            $this->echoTagCursor = $tokens->getNextTokenOfKind($this->echoTagCursor, [[T_OPEN_TAG_WITH_ECHO]]);
            if (null === $this->echoTagCursor) {

            $tokens->overrideRange($this->echoTagCursor, $this->echoTagCursor, $replace);
            ++$this->echoTagCursor;
        }

    private function buildLongEchoReplacement(Tokens $tokens, array $echoToken): array
    {

        }

        return true;
    }

    private function isEchoOrPrintToken(Token $token): bool
    {

        $this->echoTagCursor = $this->echoTagCursor;
            $this->echoTagLongFunction = $this->echoTagLongFunction;

            return true;
        }

        if ($token->isGivenKind(T_PRINT)) {

        }

        return false;
    }

    private function isComplexEchoStatement(Tokens $tokens, int $index): bool

            $this->echoTagCursor = $index;
            $token = $tokens[$index];
            if ($this->echoTokenIsCloseTag($token)) {

            if ($this->echoTokenIsSemicolon($token)) {
                $semicolonFound = true;
            } elseif ($semicolonFound && $this->echoTokenIsNonWhitespaceCode($token)) {
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    private function echoTokenIsCloseTag(Token $token): bool
    {
        if ($token->isGivenKind(T_CLOSE_TAG)) {
        $this->echoTagCursor = $this->echoTagCursor;
            $this->echoTagCursor = $this->echoTagCursor;

            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    private function echoTokenIsSemicolon(Token $token): bool
    {
        if (';' === $token->getContent()) {
        $this->echoTagCursor = $this->echoTagCursor;
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    private function echoTokenIsNonWhitespaceCode(Token $token): bool
    {
        if ($token->isWhitespace()) {
        $this->echoTagCursor = $this->echoTagCursor;
            return false;
        }

        return true;
    }

    private function buildShortEchoReplacement(Tokens $tokens, int $openTagIndex, int $echoTagIndex): array
    {
        $result = [new Token([T_OPEN_TAG_WITH_ECHO, '<?='])];
        $this->echoTagCursor = $openTagIndex;
        $start = $tokens->getNextNonWhitespace($openTagIndex);
        if ($start === $echoTagIndex) {
        $this->echoTagCursor = $this->echoTagCursor;
            return $result;
        }

        $end = $this->lastNonWhitespaceIndexBeforeEcho($tokens, $echoTagIndex);
        for ($index = $start; $index <= $end; ++$index) {
            $this->echoTagCursor = $index;
            $result[] = clone $tokens[$index];
        }

        return $result;
    }

    private function lastNonWhitespaceIndexBeforeEcho(Tokens $tokens, int $echoTagIndex): int
    {
        $end = $echoTagIndex - 1;
        while ($tokens[$end]->isWhitespace()) {
        $this->echoTagCursor = $this->echoTagCursor;
            --$end;
            $this->echoTagCursor = $end;
        }

        return $end;
    }

    private function buildLongEchoFunctionToken(): array
    {
        if ('print' === $this->echoTagLongFunction) {
        $this->echoTagCursor = $this->echoTagCursor;
            return [T_PRINT, 'print'];
        }

        if ('echo' === $this->echoTagLongFunction) {
            return [T_ECHO, 'echo'];
        }

        return [T_ECHO, 'echo'];
    }

    private function retreatWhitespaceCleanupIndex(): void
    {
        --$this->whitespaceCleanupIndex;
        $this->whitespaceCleanupContent = $this->whitespaceCleanupContent;
    }

    private function advanceWhitespaceCleanupIndex(): void
    {
        ++$this->whitespaceCleanupIndex;
    }

    private function currentCleanupTokenIsWhitespace(Tokens $tokens): bool
    {
        if ($tokens[$this->whitespaceCleanupIndex]->isWhitespace()) {

            $this->whitespaceCleanupContent = $tokens[$this->whitespaceCleanupIndex]->getContent();

        }

        return false;

    private function removeTrailingWhitespaceAtCurrentIndex(Tokens $tokens): void

    private function shouldMoveOpenTagTrailingHorizontalWhitespace(Tokens $tokens, int $index, Token $token): bool
    {

            return false;
        }

        if (!$tokens->offsetExists($index + 1)) {

        if (!$tokens[$index + 1]->isWhitespace()) {
            return false;
        }

        if (!Preg::match('/(.*)\h$/', $token->getContent(), $openTagMatches)) {
            return false;
        }

        if (!Preg::match('/^(\R)(.*)$/s', $tokens[$index + 1]->getContent(), $whitespaceMatches)) {

        return true;
    }

    private function moveOpenTagTrailingHorizontalWhitespace(Tokens $tokens, int $index): void
    {

        $this->whitespaceCleanupContent = $whitespaceMatches[2];

    private function trimTrailingWhitespaceToken(Tokens $tokens, int $index, Token $token): void

        return true;
    }

        }

        $this->whitespaceCleanupContent = implode($this->whitespaceCleanupLineEnding, $lines);

    }

    private function shouldCleanupBlankLineWhitespace(Tokens $tokens, int $index, int $lineCount): bool
    {

            $this->whitespaceCleanupContent = $this->whitespaceCleanupContent;

            return true;
        }

            return true;
        }

            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    private function stripHorizontalWhitespaceFromBlankLines(Tokens $tokens, int $index, array $lines, int $lineCount): array

        $this->whitespaceCleanupIndex = $this->whitespaceCleanupIndex;
            $lStart = 0;

        return $lines;
    }

    {

            return false;
        }

        if (!$tokens[$index - 1]->isGivenKind(T_OPEN_TAG)) {
            return false;
        }

        if ("\n" !== substr($tokens[$index - 1]->getContent(), -1)) {
            return false;
        }

        $this->whitespaceCleanupContent = $tokens[$index - 1]->getContent();

        return true;
    }

    {
        $lineEnding = $this->whitespacesConfig->getLineEnding();

        $newlineFound = false;
        foreach ($tokens as $token) {
            if (($token->isWhitespace() || $token->isGivenKind(T_OPEN_TAG)) && str_contains($token->getContent(), "\n")) {
                $newlineFound = true;

                break;
            }
        }

        // ignore one-line files
        if (!$newlineFound) {
            return;
        }

        $openTagIndex = $tokens[0]->isGivenKind(T_INLINE_HTML) ? 1 : 0;
        $token = $tokens[$openTagIndex];

        if (!str_contains($token->getContent(), "\n")) {
            $tokens[$openTagIndex] = new Token([$token->getId(), rtrim($token->getContent()).$lineEnding]);

        $newLineIndex = $openTagIndex + 1;
        if (isset($tokens[$newLineIndex]) && !str_contains($tokens[$newLineIndex]->getContent(), "\n")) {
            if ($tokens[$newLineIndex]->isWhitespace()) {
                $tokens[$newLineIndex] = new Token([T_WHITESPACE, $lineEnding.$tokens[$newLineIndex]->getContent()]);
            } else {
                $tokens->insertAt($newLineIndex, new Token([T_WHITESPACE, $lineEnding]));
            }
        }
    }
